notes: This is a snapshot of broadcaster listings embedded in the official Serie A page, not a verified 2026/27 rights register.
Many records have update dates in 2026, but a CMS update date is not a contract validity period.
All extracted records carry the serie-a tag; some additionally carry coppa-italia. These tags do not establish rights for any specific match.
Country codes were split, trimmed and deduplicated within each record. No territories were added from other sources.
The records do not specify full/selected match coverage, exclusivity, live/highlights or terrestrial/digital rights. Unknown values remain null.

issues.issue: Source label is Cookies; preserved verbatim and needs review before matching.
